description.zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线。
description.en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be deprecated.

description.zh:
消费组ID，
您可以调用[DescribeConsumerGroup](~~122886~~)接口查询消费组ID。
description.en: The ID of the consumer group. You can call the [DescribeConsumerGroup](~~122886~~) operation to query the consumer group ID.

description.zh: 消费组名称，您可以调用[DescribeConsumerGroup](~~122886~~)接口查询。
description.en: The name of the consumer group. You can call the [DescribeConsumerGroup](~~122886~~) operation to query the consumer group name.
The current password of the consumer group.

description.zh: 消费组账号，您可以使用DescribeConsumerGroup接口查询
description.en: The username of the consumer group. You can call the DescribeConsumerGroup operation to query the username.

description.zh: 数据订阅实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见[支持的地域列表](~~141033~~)。
description.en: The ID of the region where the change tracking instance resides. For more information, see [Supported regions](~~141033~~).

description.zh: 数据订阅实例ID，可以通过调用DescribeSubscriptionInstances接口查询。
description.en: The ID of the change tracking instance. You can call the DescribeSubscriptionInstances operation to query the instance ID.

description.zh:
消费组的新密码。

- 密码由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的任意两种或两种以上组成。
- 密码长度为8~32个字符。
description.en:
The new password of the consumer group.

- The password must contain characters from at least two of the following categories: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
- The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dts modify-consumer-group-password --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --subscription-instance-id dtsg2m10r1x15a0000 --consumer-group-id dtswc411cg617p0000 --consumer-group-name dtstest --consumer-group-user-name dtstest --consumer-group-password Test123456 --consumer-group-new-password Test654321 --account-id 123233440000 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dts ModifyConsumerGroupPassword --region cn-hangzhou --ConsumerGroupPassword Test123456 --ConsumerGroupID dtswc411cg617p0000 --AccountId 123233440000 --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --ConsumerGroupUserName dtstest --ConsumerGroupName dtstest --consumerGroupNewPassword Test654321 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --SubscriptionInstanceId dtsg2m10r1x15a0000
